The module needs all three files: variables.tf, main.tf, and outputs.tf. Start with variables.tf and make sure bucket_name has no default (required) while tags has default = {}.
In outputs.tf the precondition block goes inside the output block, before or after the value argument — check the syntax from the worked example.
For bucket_id, use aws_s3_bucket.main.bucket (the argument you set) rather than .id — with a mock provider .id is a random string, but .bucket always equals the name you passed in.
